profile.headline: Site Reliability Software Engineer at Google | Ex-Microsoft
profile.summary: Software Engineer; B.A. from UC Berkeley in 2017 with a double-major in Computer Science and Physics.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: • SWE on Microsoft's Azure Commercial Experiences | Subscription Lifecycle team.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Tools used: C#, Python, SQL, .NET Framework.
• Maintain and develop tools which facilitate the safe treatment and disposal of more than 55 million gallons of radioactive waste - a byproduct of nuclear weapons produced at the Hanford site during the Manhattan Project and Cold War.
• Gather requirements directly from customers; design classes / libraries & user interfaces to satisfy their requirements; implement back-end designs & GUIs; perform system tests on new releases; and support customers through acceptance testing via bug fixes and performance improvements.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
• Tools used: C#, Python, SQL, .NET Framework.
• Practiced Agile software development; contributed to the functionality of a Windows desktop application which allows chemical engineers to simulate transfers of nuclear waste.

positions.title: Computer Science Lab Assistant
positions.description:
• Tools used: Java, Git.
• Facilitated three lab sections for UC Berkeley’s Data Structures course, CS 61B.
• Showed students how to determine algorithms' time and memory efficiency.
• Taught students common algorithms for sorting, storing, retrieving data.

positions.title: Cataloging Assistant
positions.description:
• Verified that catalog information in library records is correct for new books before authorizing them to enter circulation in the university’s main library.
• Notified librarians when requested books are available for review.

positions.title: Tutor
positions.description: • Tutored high-school students in math, physics, chemistry, English, and French.

honors.title: Eagle Scout
honors.issuer: Issued by Boy Scouts of America · Jun 2013

volunteerExperiences.description: I was one of five SWE volunteers. My team used Microsoft's curriculum to teach AP Computer Science at Hanford High School in Richland, WA. Each volunteer taught one lesson per week. We trained the staff so that they can continue to offer AP CS without relying on outside help.
